script: When she texts "I can't sleep" at midnight, never reply "count sheep." Out of everyone she could text, she chose you. Don't waste that moment. Next time she says it, try one of these four, and stay until the last one. Number one: Me neither. Should we blame each other? It's playful, and it tells her you were thinking about her too. Number two: Good, tell me what's on your mind, no filter. At night, people are honest, and that creates real connection. Number three: Want me to tell you the most boring story ever until you fall asleep? It turns a text into a call. Number four: Funny. I can't sleep either. I think it's your fault. Confident, a little bolder, and impossible to forget. That's the one she'll think about when she finally falls asleep. Comment the word MIDNIGHT, and I'll send you my free playbook.
